Definition: from G1537 and G4141; to strike with astonishment:--amaze, astonish.
BiblicalUsage: ekplḗssō is how Scripture says to be astonished. In Matthew 7:28, the text says "the people were astonished at his doctrine." In Matthew 13:54, the text says "insomuch that they were astonished."
TheologicalSignificance: ekplḗssō convinces me that authority belongs to God first; every other authority answers to His. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Rejected at Nazareth; Jesus Heals a Demoniac in the Capernaum Synagogue
